test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No G is H.

II. Some R are G.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some H are not G.

II. All H are R.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution: Statement: I. No G is H. II. Some R are G. The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a3db5789856996eef468edd51f8f1a00f3aa568a1d32ee40bcbdd946a3a179.png]
